title: Forkware · A new home
question: Round two: upcoming meals first, with richer food imagery and three more distinctive compositions. Food images and meal data are illustrative.

options.label: The menu deck
options.thesis: Swipe through what’s cooking next, then explore something new.
options.viewport: A large food-led tonight card with tomorrow peeking alongside, then recipe ideas and shopping.
options.risk: Photography needs a dependable image source in the recipe model.

options.label: Your week, served
options.thesis: A compact week strip anchors a generous view of tonight’s meal.
options.viewport: A week strip, an open meal composition, and an image-led discovery shelf with an Assistant prompt.
options.risk: The week strip must stay a shortcut rather than duplicate the full planner.

options.label: Dinner & discovery
options.thesis: Tonight is the anchor; a recipe-led feed makes discovery worth opening.
options.viewport: A compact tonight feature above a bold food-led recipe suggestion, with shopping and Assistant actions.
options.risk: Discovery takes more screen space than in the other options.
